lines.en: label karinspring5:
scene sky
I’m going to Uzbekistan today.
Not literally, of course. Walls.
I mean mentally. Just not entirely mentally because I have no clue what type of place Uzbekistan actually is or why I’d ever go there in the first place. I’m sure it’s fine.

But there’s this poem I read with Ami the other day — one that dragged on for far too long — about some guy who carved out an empire and fell for some girl or something. His name was Timur and he was lame.
But he had passion — something I lack. And that made me jealous of him despite all of the anger that was gradually building up over the course of an unnecessarily long poem.
So today, my goal is to be like him. My goal is to find passion for love or imperial expansion or whatever it is that gets me to feel like I’m living for something rather than just living.
But it has to be Uzbekistan because there is no purity here and, from what I’ve heard, that’s where it’s lost. Which also means it’s where it can be found.
The adventures of Steve continue alone.
: Mmm!
scene karincarry1
Oh. Never mind. Apparently Karli is here too.
: Ugh! I never should have agreed to bring all of these ingredients to the soup kitchen alone!
: Need some help, miss?
scene karincarry2
: Oh my goodness, yes! That would be-
scene karincarry3
: Oh. It’s you.
: Don’t worry, I’m not stalking you. I’m just a concerned citizen looking out for anyone who might need help on the way to Uzbekistan.
: Ooooh, one more lie from a pathological liar. What a surprise.
: You’re saucy today, aren’t you?
scene karincarry4
: No! I’m soupy today! And I will continue to be soupy all by myself because the alternative is accepting help from a bad person!
: So do you just spend all of your free time going around the city doing nice things for people?
: Not all of it! I do nice things for animals too sometimes!
: Karin, I know you hate me, but you can let me help you. We’re in broad daylight. Do you really think I’d do something to hurt you here? After the millions of times we’ve met outside before?
scene karincarry5
: No. But I didn’t think you’d do something to hurt me when we were alone either and that backfired quite dramatically.
: Fine. I guess I’ll just leave you alone to drop all of those ingredients and let a bunch of poor and/or homeless people go hungry then.
scene karincarry1
: Mm! Why did Touka have to be busy today?! I forgot how hard this was without her help!
: Walking away now. Bye, Karin.
scene karincarry4
: Okay, fine! You can help! On one condition!
: Are you sure you’re in the position to be making demands right now?
scene karincarry6
: Are you sure you’re not a big, dumb, stupid jerk-face?
: No.
: Then no. I’m not in the position to be making demands right now. But I’m going to anyway because you owe me and because you’re an adult and you have to be nice and not scary or else.
: Or else what?
: Or else something bad is gonna happen.
: No. I don’t have more details. I might not even know what the bad thing is yet. But it’s gonna happen, Sensei. Unless you follow my demands.
: I planned on following them this whole time. I just don’t know what they are yet.
scene black
: Take the plastic bags. The paper ones have cookies in them and I do not trust you with them.
: Yes, madam. What other rules will you have me follow today?
scene karincarry7
: Stay at least five steps behind me at all times.
: Got it.
: And don’t look at me either.
scene karincarry8
: Got it.
: Liar. I bet you’re looking at me right now, aren’t you?
: I’m really not. I’m looking at a cat, actually.
scene karincarry9
: One more lie from a pathological liar. I bet-
scene karincarry10
: Aww, kitty! Look at how precious she is!
scene karincarry11
: Don’t you want to just take her home and give her a nice, warm bed to fall asleep in while you gently stroke her ears and comb her hair and buy her toys and do all sorts of nice things for her?
: Oh, right! Probably not! Because you’re a big, dumb, stupid jerk-face!

: If you’re trying to get me to disagree with that, I’m not going to. Calling me a big, dumb, stupid jerk-face is actually putting it kind of nicely. You called me way worse when we spoke near my house.
: And I meant every word!
scene karincarry12
: I guess you haven’t been horrible today, though...as much as I don’t want to admit that.
: But that doesn’t absolve you for what-
: I don’t want to be absolved. So please stop making it sound like I’m only doing this to try and be forgiven or...get back on your good side. I know that’s not going to happen.
scene karincarry13
: Even if I completely ruined our relationship, though...I can still support you. Just...silently, most of the time. When you don’t need help carrying things.
: Support me in what?
: I don’t know. Soccer? Softball? Swimming? Helping cats...and delivering scallions? All sorts of stuff.
: I’ve always been a fan of yours. Finding someone truly good in life is hard. But you have a passion for that and...you stick to it. It’s admirable. Kind of like Timur.
scene karincarry14
: Timur? Who’s that?
: Someone from a poem who’d probably become increasingly less relatable the more you knew about him.
: Do you read stuff like that often? Poetry.
: I used to. And I guess I’ve been getting back into it lately. But...mostly just to kill time. There’s not much more to it. Why do you ask?
scene karincarry15
: I just know Ami’s into that stuff and wasn’t sure if she got it from you or not.
: I read some of her entries for the poetry contest Miss Watabe ran a while ago. She’s really good. I never would have guessed. But if you were teaching her, it makes sense that-
: It wasn’t me.
scene karincarry16
: She...got that from someone else.
: Of course she’d be good at it, though. Feeling too much and needing to rely on...abstract tactics to put it into words sort of runs in the family at this point.
: I heard she’s been calling you her dad lately.
: Yeah.
: How’d that happen?
: You actually want to know?
: I could just ask her, I guess. But I try not to talk about you with other people anymore since I apparently always start acting really weird.
scene karincarry17
: Which I...used to also do as well, apparently. But it’s in a...much different way now.
: I’ve been with her longer at this point than her actual parents were before they died.
scene karincarry18
: Most of that time’s a blur to me. I’m sure it is to her too. Either that or we just block it out, but...
: Sometimes, I feel like I died with them. And that everything that’s happened afterward has been some sort of crazy dream I can’t wake up from. It’s hard to explain.
: That’s probably why I hurt you. A bunch of other people too. Losing something so important so...early on in life...
scene karincarry19
: I’m not going to wax poetic. I’ll just say that if I took it that poorly, Ami probably took it worse. And I owe it to her now to try and be what she needs me to be — a father.
scene karincarry20
: Sorry. I know you couldn’t give less of a shit about me. I should’ve just let you ask Ami.
: I’m sorry too. That...you had to go through all of that.
: It’s fine. You weren’t driving the other car.
: But if you were, it would definitely help explain the accident since you’d have been way under the legal age to drive back then.
: I can still be sorry if it wasn’t my fault. They were your family and you lost them. I don’t even want to think about how I’d feel if my parents were just...gone one day.
: Well, you’re more mature now than I’ve ever been, so I think you’d handle it better than me. But still...it’s not something I’d wish upon anyone.
: Also, since I know you’re plagued with compassion and seeing the “good” in everyone, please don’t let my past influence your thought process in terms of rationalizing my attack on you.
: It won’t...Compassion’s not a plague though, Sensei.
: I’m glad I can still feel sorry for someone who has hurt me because it helps me understand them better. Forgiveness is another thing entirely. Forgiveness needs to be earned.
: So what would it take exactly to go about earning yours, then?
scene black
: The only thing I can think of would put an end to all of this.
scene karincarry21
An end sounds nice — a place to rest — my eyes are red as robins’ breasts/
My voice is weary — jagged rasps — no voice of God, just fangs of asps//
Egyptian cobras — stanza one — he touches me, I come undone///
Just peace and quiet — tangled veins — a nest for me to go insane////

Every day, I slip closer to Him. This infection, this plague, this PARASITE, this MADNESS that ENDLESSLY hungers [[for the skin on the tips of my fingers] has STOLEN the one thing that makes me ME/////
Now, my mind rots as this body sinks deeper into a bed of nails purchased from the bishop’s kin — this bed of endless, wanton sin!
How can I be crazy?! I have a GIFT. Yet this worm torn from bodies past and placed into mine brings me NO closer to ENLIGHTENMENT.
DO NOT LET IT PASS. DO NOT LET IT REACH HIM.
He is the purest example of the depths my love can reach, and to see his insides eaten by a part of ME would-
Why-
I can hear salvation come.
scene imissyoumore
scene squishsquosh

scene karincarry21
EXT — Kanda family apartment, one hour and thirteen minutes after the departure of soup.
: Thanks for helping me today, Sensei. And for...going along with all of my demands.
: No need to thank me. I didn’t have much going on anyway.
: What are you going to do now?
: Probably go home and read some more. I need to find out about Timur’s happy ending.
: Have you come up with anything else?
: What?
: To earn my forgiveness.
: You didn’t seem to like what I proposed earlier, so maybe now is a good time to try and come up with something. If you really do want to patch things up, I mean.
: We can’t patch things up. That doesn’t work for me. I take these things and hold them inside forever. Ask the others I’ve hurt. You’ll forgive me long before I forgive myself.
: All you need to do is come upstairs.
: I can’t.
: I know.
scene karincarry22
: Because you’re a coward.
: I’m not asking you to tell them what you did to me — just to come face to face with them like a man. Introduce yourself. See that not everything revolves around you.
: But if you were to do that, it’d become too real...wouldn’t it?
: You can’t face them because you want to keep up the illusion that this is all some sort of fantasy. You want me to forgive you on my own because you think that’s just what I do.
: I’m sorry, though...because that’s just not true.
: If you really want to earn my forgiveness, I need you to show me that you want it. And if you’re not going to risk your safety for me...why should I risk mine for you?
: I can’t meet your parents, Karin. I just...
: I can’t.
scene karincarry23
: Coward.
: I’m not disagreeing with that at all. It doesn’t change the way I feel, though.
: On the bright side, at least I get to see your conscience in action this time. Watching you feel guilty and bad is rewarding in its own way.
: But if you want me back...
